{"consolidated_memory":"search/query/rewriter.ts: Empty result set bug — two separate incidents

COMPONENT: search/query/rewriter.ts (search side)
SYMPTOM (both occasions): empty result set in query rewriter — a rewritten query with no clauses left, triggered by searching for a two-word phrase containing a stop word.

FIRST OCCASION [2026-05-06]
- Trigger: manifested only for clients pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: off-by-one error in slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added property test coverage
- PR: #6522 on branch fix/empty-result-set-1
- Measured outcome: cold start latency dropped 3 percent, to 319 ms
- Test file: search/query/rewriter.test.ts (TypeScript)

SECOND OCCASION [2026-07-03]
- Trigger: manifested only on first request after a cold start
- Root cause: cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated the cache entry inside the write transaction
- PR: #9008 on branch fix/empty-result-set-2
- Measured outcome: throughput rose 46 percent, to 454 requests per second
- Test file: search/query/rewriter.test.ts (TypeScript)

Stack: TypeScript throughout."}
